summary.text: Joshua Irby is the Democratic candidate for Arkansas State Senate District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Rodney Wright.
A security professional, he described himself in a Ballotpedia survey as a civic nationalist and centrist.

paragraphs.text: Joshua Irby was born in Little Rock, Arkansas, and served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2008 to 2009.
His career experience includes working as a security professional.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has worked in corporate security for more than 15 years, from foot patrol officer to managing global security intelligence for a Fortune 500 company.
Irby said in the survey that he moved from Little Rock to Bryant in 2022.
He listed local control, education reform, infrastructure investment, fair elections including open primaries, paper ballots and ending gerrymandering, and constitutional rights among his priorities.
